main_text.p: controuerti, nempe constitui Sacramenta ex Dei ordinatione,tribus istis,nimirum Signis, Rebus significatis,&verbo Sacramentali,quo duo illa fiunt quod sunt,& inter se Sacramen-taliter copulantur.
main_text.head: CAPVT I.
De signis Sacramentalibus,& eorundem cum rebus significatis analogia.
main_text.p: ANTEQVAM vero quænam hæc signa sint dicamus, statuendum est in primis, non de vulgaribus signis, sed diuinitus ad magna illa nostræ salutis mysteria significanda constitutis, hic agi: ac proinde ad hoc vt hæc vere signa esse in hac actione sacra censeantur, præsupponi diuinæ illius ordinationis legitimam obseruationem.Signa Sacramentalia duabus notis, nempe, & rerum naturalis quas significant, & significationis sine atque energia à vulgaribus signis distinguuntur.

Secundò sciendum est res istas non simpliciter idcirco signa fieri & dici, quòd in oculos nostros incurrētes, instar picturæ quędam nostræ recordationi suggerant: sed vt res per illas significatæ, & per fidem apprehensæ, intrà nos,verè diuina virtute,obsignentur: quo discrimine signa ista ab illis, recordationis tantùm causa,constitutis signis,& Sacramentalis significatio ab aliis simplicioribus dis-cernuntur.

page.notes: Woodcut border between the first paragraph and the heading, and a large woodcut initial "A" at the start of the body text; both are decorative and not transcribed. The initial is joined to the small-capital "NTEQVAM". The margin note is a single block of text across several lines beside the first two paragraphs. Possible doubtful readings: "sine" in the margin note (the scan may read "fine"), and "vere" in the body text. No catchword is printed.
